title: Youtrip Debit Card 4% Cashback on International Purchases for 6 Months ($25/Month Cap) for New Customers
body:
Deal: Youtrip Debit Card 4% Cashback on International Purchases for 6 Months ($25/Month Cap) for New Customers

[internet-stranger] Used these guys a fair bit.
The 4% works on any international purchase.
Nice to get an extra 4% off on all those AliExpress purchases :)
[tenpercent] do they require selfie or video verification? do they offer alternative non-biometric options?
[valleyrain] Yes, they do require video verification when I tried to sign up. Not sure about alternative options if declined.
[FujinShu] Does international include domestic purchases as well, or is it only purchases outside of Australia?
[McMaferMur] When travelling why we need this if we have Ing Macquarie debit card?
[ilovefullprice] What’s considered as “International Purchases”?
[GJT] Guys, you can get the $10 credit through referrals as well. Also the referral link is only valid for 30 days, so update your referrals. When you open the app, it should say someone referred you. For some reason, it showed me an error first but when I closed the error, it showed who referred me and after topping up $10 I got the $10 credit too.
[gadgetguy] Are they taking a margin on the exchange rates? Are their rates published anywhere?
[GJT] 0% fees - https://support-au.you.co/hc/en-us/articles/12841078675343-W…
[hiya] does adding youtrip balance using credit card count as Cash Advance in my credit card?
[samxspam] Travelling tomorrow morning, is the card available to add instantly on Apple pay?
